item.title: Ask HN: If you're burning tokens at scale, what are you using them for?
item.summary: I know lots of people use tokens to run coding agents, but I'm interested in hearing from people who are burning large amounts of tokens on automated tasks that aren't driving some kind of agent. Do you have processes set up that are e.g. processing documents, audio, or video files? Particularly interested in hearing from people doing this in a business context.
